name: Kamaishi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Kamaishi city emblem in white: an outlined ring with four small points enclosing two vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Kamaishi, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 May 1937.

features.role: Kamaishi city emblem — an outlined ring with four small points enclosing two vertical bars
